integrity: The proof is exact and non-computational. It reconstructs the upper estimate from the published free norm and proves sharpness with two explicit lattice homomorphisms; no independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result proves optimality only for the canonical restriction map to C(K_L); it does not determine the least distortion among all lattice isomorphisms to arbitrary C(K)-spaces. The closest 2022 theorem already proves the factor-two upper bound, and an equivalent sharpness observation may exist under different terminology despite targeted searches.
title: Exact factor two for the canonical \(C(K_L)\) representation of \(\operatorname{FBL}\langle L\rangle\)
